cases.name: a-running-total-down-a-column
cases.description: The ledger. Row i is the accumulation of every row up to it, which is the one thing a row cannot compute from its own index — so the streaming engines refuse it by name and the router sends the config to the in-memory one.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="ledger" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Op"><gen type="number" value="-400..500"/></sequence><sequence name="Balance"><gen type="running" of="Op" accumulate="sum" base="1000"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Op}} ${{Balance}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-running-total-that-restarts-per-group
cases.description: reset= splits the column into segments and accumulates each on its own — one balance per account rather than one for the file. The decimals stay exact because the arithmetic is the same scaled-integer fold the list flavour uses.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="9" seed="acct" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Account"><gen type="text" value="A,A,A,B,B,C,C,C,C" order="sequential"/></sequence><sequence name="Op"><gen type="number" value="10..99" decimals="2"/></sequence><sequence name="Balance"><gen type="running" of="Op" accumulate="sum" reset="Account"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Account}} ${{Op}} ${{Balance}}</data></line></block></tdc>

cases.name: a-running-maximum-down-a-column
cases.description: The high-water mark: the largest value seen so far. Like the list flavour, min and max return an element that already exists rather than a reformatted one.
cases.config: <tdc><env count="6" seed="peak" local="en" mode="memory"><sequence name="Load"><gen type="number" value="10..99"/></sequence><sequence name="Peak"><gen type="running" of="Load" accumulate="max"/></sequence></env><block><line><data>${{Load}} ${{Peak}}</data></line></block></tdc>
